items.text: Shopee Seller Advisor, AI decisions for small Vietnamese sellers
How far AI coding agents can go on a production-grade system
Postgres RLS, LLM guardrails, privacy-first data pipelines

projects.title: Shopee Seller Advisor
projects.description: AI decision assistant that turns a small Shopee seller's exported data and unit costs into at most 5 explained actions a week, then measures whether each one paid off.
highlights: **Rules first, LLM explains.** The engine computes every number; the model writes text with `{{placeholders}}`, and any stray digit in its output is rejected.
**Privacy by construction.** Seller Centre exports are parsed in the browser and buyer PII columns are dropped before anything is uploaded.
**Tenant isolation in Postgres.** Row-level security on every shop table, with a generated test suite that fails if a new table skips it.
**Built like it'll have real users.** 9 ADRs, Better Auth with 2FA and breached-password checks, a Postgres job queue, and compliance docs for Vietnam's AI law.

footer.quote: Every number is computed, never generated.
